questions.question: When the nightly batch posts daily card transactions, what checks cause a transaction to be rejected and what reason is recorded for each?
questions.why: Looks up the card in the cross-reference and the account, rejecting with reasons 100-103 for bad card, missing account, over limit, or expired account.

questions.question: How does the interest calculation fall back when an account's disclosure group has no matching interest rate record?
questions.why: On status 23 from the disclosure group read it retries with the DEFAULT group code to get the default interest rate.

questions.question: After a user signs in successfully, how does the system decide which menu they land on, and what happens on a wrong password or unknown user?
questions.why: Compares the stored password, then XCTLs to the admin or regular menu by user type; otherwise shows wrong-password or not-found messages.

questions.question: In the account record copybook, what is the picture clause of ACCT-GROUP-ID?
questions.why: Defines ACCT-GROUP-ID as PIC X(10) at the end of the account record.

questions.question: How is the account master VSAM cluster defined in JCL, in terms of key length and record size?
questions.why: IDCAMS DEFINE CLUSTER with KEYS(11 0), RECORDSIZE(300 300), INDEXED, shareoptions 2 3.

questions.question: What does the online bill payment screen do once the customer confirms payment, and when does it refuse?
questions.why: Refuses when the balance is zero or negative, else writes a bill-payment transaction for the full balance and reduces the account balance.

questions.question: How does the card authorization service decide whether to approve or decline a request, and which response reason codes can it return?
questions.why: Declines when the amount exceeds available credit (summary or account), sets response code 00/05 and reason codes by condition.

questions.question: How does the cleanup job for pending authorizations decide that an authorization is old enough to delete?
questions.why: Converts the stored auth date, computes age in days against the expiry threshold and, if expired, marks for delete and backs out the summary counts.

questions.question: What do the condition names YYYYMMDD-IN and YYYY-MM-DD-IN under CODATECN-TYPE represent?
questions.why: Input type flag: value 1 means YYYYMMDD input, value 2 means YYYY-MM-DD input.

questions.question: Which alternate index is defined on the transaction master VSAM file, and on what key position and length?
questions.why: DEFINE ALTERNATEINDEX with KEYS(26 304), non-unique, upgraded, related to the transaction KSDS.

questions.question: What happens when an operator reports fraud on an authorization that already has a fraud record in DB2?
questions.why: Insert is tried first; on duplicate key (-803) it falls into an UPDATE of the fraud flag and report date.

questions.question: How does the online report screen work out the start and end dates for the monthly transaction report?
questions.why: Start is first of current month, end is last day of the month computed via integer-of-date arithmetic.

questions.question: When another system asks for account details over a message queue, what does the service reply with, and what if the account does not exist?
questions.why: For an inquiry function it reads the account file and replies with balance/limits/dates, or an invalid-request message if not found.

questions.question: What value does WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES hold in the credit card list program COCRDLIC?
questions.why: Sets the page size of the card list to 7 rows.

questions.question: What is the segment hierarchy of the pending authorization IMS database and what are the sequence keys?
questions.why: HIDAM database with root PAUTSUM0 keyed on ACCNTID and child PAUTDTL1 keyed on PAUT9CTS, with an index.

questions.question: How does the batch program that maintains the DB2 transaction type table interpret each input line?
questions.why: Evaluates the first-column record type: A inserts, U updates, D deletes, * is a comment, anything else is an error.

questions.question: What does the online transaction type maintenance screen tell the user when a delete is blocked because other records depend on the type?
questions.why: On SQLCODE -532 it sets a failure and builds a message asking to delete child records first.

questions.question: How does the transaction type list screen support paging forward and backward while filtering by code or description?
questions.why: Two DB2 cursors, ascending and descending on type code, with optional type and description filters.

questions.question: In CBPAUP0C, what expiry days value is used when P-EXPIRY-DAYS is not numeric?
questions.why: Defaults the expiry threshold to 5 days when the parameter is not numeric.

questions.question: How is the password input hidden on the sign-on screen map?
questions.why: PASSWD field is an 8-character unprotected field with the DRK (dark) attribute.

questions.question: How does the card update screen protect against overwriting changes that someone else made while the user was editing?
questions.why: Reads the card with UPDATE, compares current values to the originally displayed ones and refuses if they differ.

questions.question: How does the detailed transaction report decide which transactions are included and when does it print totals?
questions.why: Filters by processing date range, writes account totals when the card changes, looks up xref, type and category for each line.

questions.question: What format rules does the manual add-transaction screen enforce on the amount entered?
questions.why: Amount must be sign, 8 digits, a decimal point and 2 digits (-99999999.99).

questions.question: In paragraph 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING of COTRTUPC, what happens when the UPDATE returns SQLCODE +100?
questions.why: A not-found update falls through to 9700-INSERT-RECORD to insert the row.

questions.question: What referential rule ties the transaction type category table to the transaction type table in DB2?
questions.why: Composite primary key (type code, category) and a foreign key to TRANSACTION_TYPE with ON DELETE RESTRICT.

questions.question: How does the shared date validation logic reject a date of birth?
questions.why: Converts both dates to integers and flags an error if the entered date is not earlier than today (cannot be in the future).

questions.question: What common header fields does every record in the branch-migration export file carry before its type-specific data?
questions.why: Record type, timestamp, sequence number, branch id, region code, then a 460-byte data area redefined per record type.

questions.question: How does the statement generation program walk through customers and what does it look up for each one?
questions.why: Loops over cross-reference records, fetching customer and account, writing the statement, then reading that card's transactions.

questions.question: What does paragraph 8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY in COPAUA0C do to the summary counters when an authorization is declined?
questions.why: Adds to the declined count and amount (approved path updates approved counts and credit balance), then replaces or inserts the summary segment.

questions.question: In the transaction report procedure, how are transactions filtered by date and ordered before the report program runs?
questions.why: A SORT step orders by card number and includes only records between the start and end date parameters.
